[P1] Finalize plugins before rethrowing a late checkpoint failure

When the handler throws after an async step returns and its queued SUCCEED subsequently fails with a 503, this throw exits the catch block after the existing RETRYING finalization branch has already been passed. Consequently, `onInvocationEnd` is never called, pending operation-hook work is not drained, and telemetry is not flushed. The added error-classification guard fixes the permanent-error case but leaves this part of the prior finding unresolved. Route the classified late error through common finalization so plugins receive exactly one RETRYING notification before rethrowing. Extend the composed handler-rejection test to assert invocation-end delivery and draining of pending hook work.
